governance.retention: aggregated datasets kept indefinitely; row-level pseudonymised data follows the retention of its source assets and is purged with them
governance.sharingPolicy: tenant-scoped by row-level keys; anonymised cross-tenant benchmarks and validated-consumption data products shared only in aggregate; exports to a tenant's own BI tools under its control

subGroups.name: Platform Core and Integration
subGroups.description: The foundation that makes one platform serve 50+ energy companies: tenant and brand configuration, the workflow tasks and exceptions that route human work, and the integration connections to market parties, exchanges, banks and enterprise systems.

assets.name: Tenant Organization
assets.description: An energy company operating on the platform and its configuration: legal entity, market roles held (supplier licence per country, BRP, metering responsible party, shipper) with market-party identifiers (EAN-13 party codes and EIC codes in the Netherlands, CNMC registration and distributor agent codes in Iberia), heritage product of origin (Ecedo, Energy21 EBASE, Jules, Gridhub, Nemon) and migration state, the brands and white-label portals with their themes and domains, enabled modules and suites, subscription tier, connection and MWh volumes for billing the platform, market-communication certificates and mailbox configuration, feature flags and market-change rollout state (Allocation 2.0 tranches, 15-minute day-ahead), data-residency and processor-agreement terms, staff users, roles and mandate limits, and the managed-services scope (BRP as a Service) the platform operates on the tenant's behalf. Administered by Identity, Tenants and Brand Isolation (iden) and consumed by Migration and Platform Consolidation Tooling (migr).
assets.businessMeaning: The isolation and consolidation boundary: every asset on the platform is keyed by tenant, and one platform for five heritage products depends on tenant configuration being complete and correct.
assets.accessScope: the platform operator's tenant administrators and customer-success staff; each tenant's own administrators for their organisation, brands, users and mandates; never visible across tenants

interfaces.name: tenant and brand api
interfaces.description: Tenant, market-role, brand, module, feature-flag, user, role and mandate administration API used by tenant administration, identity, every business module for tenant context, migration tooling and platform billing.

interfaces.name: tenant configuration events
interfaces.description: Tenant onboarded, market role activated, brand published, module enabled, feature flag rolled out, user or mandate changed and tenant migrated events consumed by all modules, market-communication hubs and the migration console.

governance.retention: kept for the platform contract term plus 7 years for platform invoicing and licence evidence; staff user records deleted 12 months after deactivation; certificates rotated and retired per market-party rules
governance.sharingPolicy: never shared between tenants; market-party identifiers exchanged with EDSN, TenneT, CNMC and distributors as market roles require

assets.name: Workflow Task
assets.description: A unit of human or automated work routed by the platform: billing and reconciliation exceptions, rejected market messages and overdue responses, credit-check referrals, nomination and gate-closure alerts, position-limit breaches, disconnection approvals, regulatory-report deadlines, migration checklists and customer-service escalations; each with the triggering object and rule, the tenant and team queue, assignee, priority and due date against the applicable service level or statutory term, checklist steps, decision and outcome, the notification sent (e-mail, in-app, chat, SMS) and its acknowledgement, escalation history, and cycle-time and ageing statistics per task type. Managed by Workflow, Exceptions and Notifications (wflw) on behalf of every business module.
assets.businessMeaning: Where cost to serve hides: the number, age and root cause of exceptions per process is the operational truth behind straight-through billing, timely nominations and compliant deadlines.
assets.accessScope: the assigned staff and team queues of the owning tenant; the BRP-as-a-Service and support desks of the platform operator for tasks in managed scope; task content inherits the access rules of the object it refers to

interfaces.name: workflow task api
interfaces.description: Task create, route, assign, act, escalate, complete and query API with rule definitions and notification templates, used by every business module, the exceptions workspace, the BRP operations desk and dashboards.

interfaces.name: workflow events
interfaces.description: Task created, assigned, due soon, overdue, escalated and completed events consumed by notifications, dashboards and the triggering modules.

governance.retention: completed tasks kept 3 years for process analysis, longer where they document a decision on a fiscal or regulatory record; personal data in task payloads purged with the source object
governance.sharingPolicy: internal to the owning tenant and the platform desks operating in its managed scope; never shared between tenants

assets.name: Integration Connection
assets.description: A configured connection between a tenant and an external system: Dutch market interfaces (EDSN message gateway, C-AR, TenneT MMC-Hub and E-programme interface, GTS nomination interface, ETPA and EPEX trading APIs, CertiQ), Iberian interfaces (SIPS, distributor ATR file exchange, OMIE, REE, MIBGAS), price and weather data feeds, smart-meter and telemetry data providers, flex-asset and battery controllers, ERP and accounting systems, payment providers and banks, print and messaging providers, and the tenant's own systems using the open REST API and webhooks; each with connector type and version, endpoint and protocol, certificate or credential reference in the vault, schedule and rate limits, field mappings and transformations, health and last-success status, error and retry statistics, API keys and webhook subscriptions issued to the tenant, and the audit log of calls. Administered by Open API and Integration Connectors (apip).
assets.businessMeaning: How the platform stays certified and integrated: a broken market interface stops switches and nominations for a whole tenant, and the open API is how customers extend the platform without waiting for the vendor.
assets.accessScope: the platform's integration engineers and the tenant's integration administrators; credentials and certificates readable only by the connector runtime through the vault; health status visible to operations dashboards

interfaces.name: integration connection api
interfaces.description: Connector catalogue, configure, test, enable, rotate credentials, API-key and webhook management and health API used by the integration console, the market-communication hubs, price and meter data ingestion, payment and accounting connectors and tenant developers.

interfaces.name: integration health events
interfaces.description: Connection established, call failed, retry exhausted, certificate expiring, rate limit reached and connection disabled events consumed by workflow alerts, market-communication monitoring and platform dashboards.

governance.retention: configuration kept for the tenant contract term; call audit logs kept 12 months for security and 7 years where they evidence market-message exchange; retired credentials destroyed on rotation
governance.sharingPolicy: never shared between tenants; endpoint identities exchanged with the external party they connect to; credentials never leave the vault

stores.name: Product Catalog DB
stores.description: Multi-tenant relational schema (PostgreSQL-style, row-level tenant keys) for products, effective-dated tariff versions, dynamic-pricing formulas, eligibility rules, campaigns, channel configuration and B2B quotes with curve snapshot references.

stores.name: Customer and Contract DB
stores.description: Relational store for customer accounts, consents, connection points with attribute history, supply contracts with effective-dated prices and the projection of latest readings per connection; access-logged, tenant-keyed, the heart of the order-to-cash backbone.

stores.name: Central Connection Register Mirror
stores.description: Local mirror of the EDSN central connection register (C-AR) and the Iberian distributor SIPS extracts, refreshed by daily delta files and register messages, used for lookups and register reconciliation.

stores.name: Customer Search Index
stores.description: Search index over customers, EAN and CUPS connection points, addresses and contracts for the back office, care workspace and portal lookups.

stores.name: Market Process DB
stores.description: Relational store for switch, move and other market-process instances, message state, acknowledgements, retries and response-term timers for the Dutch and Iberian market hubs.

stores.name: Market Message Queue
stores.description: Durable message queues for inbound and outbound market messages and integration calls, guaranteeing ordered, at-least-once processing of EDSN, MMC-Hub, SIPS, ATR, OMIE and REE traffic across 20 million connections per day.

stores.name: Market Message Archive
stores.description: Immutable, write-once object storage for raw market-message payloads, transport receipts, allocation and reconciliation files, TSO programme messages and settlement files, retained 7 years.

stores.name: Billing Ledger DB
stores.description: Relational sub-ledger for invoices and specifications, billing corrections, payment transactions, direct-debit batches, open items, customer balances and debtor cases, tenant-keyed and reconciled to the tenant's accounting system.

stores.name: Customer Document Store
stores.description: Object storage for signed contracts with e-signature evidence, invoice PDFs and specifications, letters and dunning notices, quotes, trade confirmations, PPA documents and inbound scans, versioned and retention-classed per document type and tenant.

stores.name: Bank Statement Landing Zone
stores.description: SFTP-fed object storage for camt.053 statements, pain.002 rejections, PSP settlement reports and outbound pain.008 direct-debit batches before matching in the billing ledger.

stores.name: Accounting Connector Mirror
stores.description: Staging and reconciliation mirror of journals, invoices, payments, imbalance settlements and hedge settlements exchanged with tenants' ERP and accounting systems.

stores.name: Portal Identity DB
stores.description: Identity store for portal and app accounts, federated identities, multi-factor settings, mandates and scopes, notification preferences and authentication logs, isolated per brand and tenant.

stores.name: Service Case DB
stores.description: Relational store for omnichannel service cases, context snapshots, actions and notes, escalations, satisfaction scores and communication projections for the care workspace and portal.

stores.name: Meter Data Landing Zone
stores.description: Object storage for daily P4 and metering-party interval deliveries, telemetry feeds and Iberian distributor measurement files before parsing and validation.

stores.name: Meter Data Time-Series Store
stores.description: Partitioned time-series database for 15-minute and hourly interval series per EAN and CUPS with quality flags and version history, register readings, and the derived consumption profiles and load curves; sized for 20 million connections per day.

stores.name: Allocation and Settlement DB
stores.description: Relational and columnar store for allocation volumes per BRP, grid area and settlement period, reconciliation runs, imbalance settlement computations, TSO invoice reconciliation and segment attribution.

stores.name: Forecast and Position Store
stores.description: Time-series store for forecast runs per portfolio segment and horizon, intraday positions per 15 minutes, steering-signal effects and position snapshots, feeding the guaranteed intraday cycle and the 15-minute financial insight.

stores.name: Nomination DB
stores.description: Relational store for E-programmes, gas nominations, re-nominations, TSO acknowledgements, version history and gate-closure timers with four-eyes approval records.

stores.name: Steering Signal Topic
stores.description: Low-latency streaming topics for position updates, imbalance price signals and steering signals to traders, asset controllers and exchange connectors, with replay for evaluation.

stores.name: Trading and Risk DB
stores.description: Relational store for hedge transactions, PPAs, customer click trades, mandate limits, portfolio position snapshots, valuations and risk measures with regulatory-reporting status.

stores.name: Market Data Landing Zone
stores.description: Object storage for scheduled price, settlement and weather files and stream captures from EPEX, ETPA, TenneT, EEX, ICE Endex, OMIE, MIBGAS and weather providers before normalisation.

stores.name: Market Data Time-Series Store
stores.description: Time-series database for spot, intraday, imbalance and futures prices, gas and GO prices, weather series, forward curves and immutable pricing-curve snapshots used by quotes, contracts and valuations.

stores.name: Energy Data Warehouse
stores.description: Columnar analytics warehouse with row-level tenant keys and pseudonymisation that loads every operational asset for dashboards, KPI datasets, the 15-minute financial insight per segment, regulatory reporting and anonymised cross-tenant benchmarks.

stores.name: Analytics Export Store
stores.description: Object storage for scheduled CSV and Parquet extracts to tenants' BI and finance tools, consumption reports for customers and anonymised benchmark exports.

stores.name: Regulatory Report Store
stores.description: Versioned object storage for generated regulatory filings, submission files, receipts and the dataset versions they were produced from, plus TSO settlement statements.

stores.name: Tenant Configuration DB
stores.description: Relational store for tenant organisations, market roles and party identifiers, brands and themes, enabled modules, feature flags, staff users, roles and mandates, and migration state.

stores.name: Workflow Task DB
stores.description: Relational store for workflow tasks, rules, queues, checklists, notifications, escalations and cycle-time statistics across all business modules.

stores.name: Integration Configuration DB
stores.description: Relational store for connector configurations, endpoints, schedules, field mappings, API keys and webhook subscriptions, health status and call audit logs.

stores.name: Integration Secrets Vault
stores.description: Key-management service holding market-communication certificates, TSO and exchange credentials, bank and PSP keys and tenant API secrets, readable only by connector runtimes.

stores.name: Domain Event Bus
stores.description: Message bus carrying customer, contract, switch, invoice, payment, nomination, settlement and workflow domain events between modules, tenant-partitioned with replay for projections and audit.
